material_changes: Host-smoke runner records observed_value, observed_stdout_text, and observed_value_key on each host probe row before media authority is used.
Host-smoke receipt validator recomputes host-probe stdout_sha256 from observed_stdout_text, rejects multi-token probe output, and requires each observed_value to match the corresponding host.* field.
Host-smoke receipt schema now distinguishes host probe rows through a hostProbeResult definition requiring replayable probe fields.
Release-critical host-smoke checker includes tamper regressions for host-probe observed_value drift and stdout replay drift.
Proof-bundle example and generated cube artifacts were refreshed for 2026-06-13r570 while keeping the front-door budget green.
open_risks: Real non-simulated FreeBSD host proof is still absent.
The host-proof path is much harder to import incorrectly, but still needs an actual FreeBSD run.
docs/00-index.md remains close to its front-door byte budget.
Canonical JSON remains the restricted no-float profile, not full arbitrary-number RFC 8785 JCS.
summary: Rev0539 hardens the FreeBSD host-proof path by making host-probe evidence replayable: probe rows now carry observed stdout text and values that validators bind to receipt host fields.
